title: Pending badge background rendered black — `bg: 'gray'` is not a valid Chakra UI color token
STATUS_OPTIONS in TaskFilters missing 'overdue' — no dropdown feedback when Overdue card active
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/tasks/TaskFilters.jsx:29-35`

**Root Cause:** `STATUS_OPTIONS` contains `''`, `'pending'`, `'in_progress'`, `'done'` but not `'overdue'`. When the Overdue summary card sets `filters.normalizedStatus = 'overdue'`, the controlled `<Select>` finds no matching `<option>` and renders "All Statuses", giving no visual indication the filter is active. This compounds TK-007.

**Claude Fix Prompt:** See TK-007 fix prompt — both fixes are in the same change.
fixEvidence: Already present in `TaskFilters.jsx` — confirmed in source; no change needed

title: `requirementId` null for AuditNonConformance — inconsistent within same 'audit' module
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-backend/src/modules/tasks/tasks.normalise.js:91-121`

**Root Cause:** `requirementId` was added to `normaliseAuditScopeItem` (= `controlNumber`) but not to `normaliseNonConformance`. Both have `sourceModule: 'audit'` and appear in the same Module group. AuditScopeItem rows display a `controlNumber` chip; AuditNonConformance rows show nothing in that position.

**Claude Fix Prompt:**
In `vibrantix-backend/src/modules/tasks/tasks.normalise.js` inside the `normaliseNonConformance` return object, add:
```js
requirementId: nc.controlReference || nc.controlNumber || null,
```
First check the `AuditNonConformance` model for the correct field name.

title: Vendor `navigateTo` null vendorId produces broken URL `/vendors//assessments/:id`
description:
**Files:** `vendor-service/src/routes/internal-tasks.routes.ts:128`

**Root Cause:** `navigateTo: \`/vendors/${doc.vendorId?.toString() ?? ''}/assessments/${doc._id.toString()}\`` produces `/vendors//assessments/:id` when `vendorId` is null. Next.js App Router returns 404 for this URL.

**Claude Fix Prompt:**
In `vendor-service/src/routes/internal-tasks.routes.ts` line 128:
```ts
navigateTo: doc.vendorId
  ? `/vendors/${doc.vendorId.toString()}/assessments/${doc._id.toString()}`
  : `/vendors`,
```

title: Done task counts inconsistent — AuditScopeItem/CI include done, all other entities exclude at query level
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-backend/src/modules/tasks/tasks.service.js` (Queries 1 and 8)

**Root Cause:** AuditScopeItem (Query 1) has no status filter — closed scope items (done) are included. ContinuousImprovement (Query 8) flat-maps all non-deleted initiatives regardless of status. All other 6 entity types exclude done tasks at query time. `summary.done` reflects only these two sources.

**Claude Fix Prompt:**
For a task dashboard (showing open work), exclude done tasks consistently from all queries. Add to AuditScopeItem query:
```js
.find({ assignee: userObjectId, organizationId: orgObjectId, isDeleted: { $ne: true },
        assessmentStatus: { $nin: ['closed', 'not_applicable'] } })
```
And add status filter to CI flat-map:
```js
.filter(init =>
  init.assignedTo &&
  init.assignedTo.toString() === userIdStr &&
  !init.deletedAt &&
  !['completed', 'cancelled'].includes(init.status)
)
```
Remove the Done card from TaskSummaryBar if all done tasks are excluded, or decide to include done tasks everywhere (Approach B).

title: ContinuousImprovement flat-map calls `init.assignedTo.toString()` — TypeError if `assignedTo` null
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-backend/src/modules/tasks/tasks.service.js:276-284`

**Root Cause:** `init.assignedTo.toString() === userIdStr` throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toString')` if `assignedTo` is null/undefined. This propagates out of `Promise.all` and returns HTTP 500 to the frontend.

**Claude Fix Prompt:**
In `vibrantix-backend/src/modules/tasks/tasks.service.js` CI flat-map filter:
```js
.filter(init =>
  init.assignedTo &&
  init.assignedTo.toString() === userIdStr &&
  !init.deletedAt,
)
```
Apply the same null guard to the ManagementReview flat-map for `item.assignedTo`.
fixEvidence: Already present: `init.assignedTo &&` guard confirmed in source

title: ManagementReview flat-map calls `item.assignedTo.toString()` without null guard — same crash risk as TK-014
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-backend/src/modules/tasks/tasks.service.js:264-272`

**Root Cause:** The ManagementReview flat-map filter checks `item.assignedTo && item.assignedTo.toString() === userIdStr`. The `&&` guard IS present for `item.assignedTo`, so this is NOT a crash bug. However, `item.assignedTo` comparison uses `.toString()` which for ObjectId types works correctly, but there is no guard against the case where `item.assignedTo` is stored as a plain string (not ObjectId). If stored as a string, `item.assignedTo.toString() === userIdStr` still works. The real risk is the ContinuousImprovement flat-map (TK-014) which lacks this guard entirely. TK-018 is a verification note — the ManagementReview flat-map already has the null guard; TK-014 does not.

**Claude Fix Prompt:**
This defect should be marked ❓ CANNOT_VERIFY pending confirmation that the ManagementReview flat-map truly lacks the null guard. Read `tasks.service.js` lines 264–272 and verify whether `item.assignedTo &&` is present. If the null guard is there, close as ⚪ WONT_FIX. If missing, apply same fix as TK-014.
fixEvidence: Already present: `item.assignedTo &&` guard confirmed in source

title: Summary bar counts computed from `filtered` (post-filter), not total tasks — counts shift when any filter active
Done summary card permanently shows 0 — done tasks excluded from all queries; card is permanently misleading
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/tasks/TaskSummaryBar.jsx:38-40` · `vibrantix-backend/src/modules/tasks/tasks.service.js`

**Root Cause:** The TK-013 fix excluded done tasks from all entity queries at the MongoDB level (e.g., `assessmentStatus: { $nin: ['closed', 'not_applicable'] }` for AuditScopeItem, `status: { $nin: ['closed', 'verified', 'cancelled'] }` for AuditNonConformance, etc.). The microservices also exclude done statuses at their query level. As a result `summary.done` is always 0. Clicking the Done card passes `normalizedStatus='done'` and the backend returns 0 tasks. The Done card provides no value and misleads users into thinking they have 0 completed tasks.

**Claude Fix Prompt:**
Remove the Done card from `TaskSummaryBar.jsx` since done tasks are intentionally excluded from the dashboard scope. Update `SUMMARY_CONFIG` to remove the `done` entry:
```js
const SUMMARY_CONFIG = [
  { key: 'pending', ... },
  { key: 'in_progress', ... },
  { key: 'overdue', ... },
  // Done removed — tasks dashboard shows open work only
];
```
And update `SimpleGrid columns={{ base: 2, md: 4 }}` to `{{ base: 2, md: 3 }}`.
